description: Elections Commission - Amended Notice for Local Authorities in Matara District (Order under Section 38(3) of the L. A. E. O.)
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, specifically the postponement of local authority elections and the announcement of a new election date. It references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, provides notice of poll changes, and lists the affected local government bodies. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover election announcements, schedules, and related electoral commission decisions.
